segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin describe the gel as light and non-greasy, with several saying it stopped chronic breakouts and layered well under makeup, though one oily/combo reviewer said it did nothing but irritate her skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: some report clearer, hydrated skin and smooth makeup application, while others report dryness, tightness, irritation, or breakouts from the same product.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers who tolerated the product report long-term clearing of acne and easy use alongside actives like retinol and acids, but other reviews describe burning, irritation, and strong fragrance as problems for reactive skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her fifties with a long history of oily skin says this is the first moisturizer that has not left her greasy or broken out.

concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers with acne-prone skin credit this moisturizer with clearing hairline, chin, and cheek breakouts and preventing new ones over months of use; one reviewer says it caused a breakout and another describes cystic-type irritation and worsened acne.
concerns.blemishes: Several long-term users report their skin stayed clear or improved noticeably since starting the product, describing it as a holy-grail for acne-prone skin; one reviewer felt it did nothing for her blemishes but irritate the skin.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers say the gel is hydrating and lightweight with skin feeling soft after use, but one acne-prone reviewer says it dried her face out so badly it felt tight and itchy.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a burning, irritating sensation attributed to the fragrance, while others report no irritation at all even alongside other actives.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the gel as controlling oil without feeling smothering, letting long-time oily-skinned users go without the greasy feel they got from other moisturizers.

extraits.texte: i bought the product thinking it was going to be very refreshing on my face. it however didnt seem to do that at all. So much fragrance on the product and broke me out as i continued to use it. i thought maybe it was pruging however moisturers are not likely to cause purging. just was NOT worth the price bcs it did absolutely nothing for my skin but irritate it. i have combo skin and expected so much more from this product.

Not a fan of this moisturizer. I have acne prone skin and I can get a little oily. This dried my face out so bad. Felt tight and itchy. And the smell is terrible. Very perfumy. It lingers after you put it on so I would smell it for a while.

I am on my third bottle of this. I was trying all kinds of different products to clear up the acne I get in my hairline, eyebrows, and around my chin. I have senstive skin so trying new products is a very long (and expensive) process of trial and error. I ended up decided to cut back to just a face wash, moisterizer, and spf. My skin looked clearer than it ever had in over a decade using this. Just to be sure it was this product I subbed another moisterizer for a week and i started getting breakouts again. Went back to this and cleared it up quick. I will never be without this in my skincare routine. I slowly added back in various products like an acid in the morning and retinol at night and I can still tolerate using this everyday with other products. I only use this water gel in the morning. As long as i let it settle for a couple minutes, I have no issues with pilling with my SPF and makeup. Only downside is that i much prefer the previous packaging that had the pump.

extraits.titre: Long time moisturizer for acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I have tried countless moisturizers over the years, and I keep coming back to this one (3+ years). A family member of mine is an esthetician, so even after years of trying different high cost brand moisturizers, none work like this one. When I do try to switch, I break out due to my sensitive skin. I have super sensitive skin due to allergies, and I've struggled with acne for years. It will most likely be the only moisturizer I will use for the rest of my life. I'm bummed they don't sell it in stores anymore, so now I have to order online. Nevertheless, after many trials and errors of different products, I will forever be the poster child for this stuff.

extraits.titre: The ONLY moisturizer that's ever worked for me
extraits.texte: I'm 56. I have acne prone, slightly oily skin. Until my 50's I always had very oily skin. No matter how much money I spent, moisturizers and sunscreens left me greasy, my skin feeling smothered and broken out. This is the first moisturizer I've ever been able to use. Its so light and refreshing, I absolutely love it. I have not had a single breakout from this. My skin drinks it in. My other products work well with this and my make up goes over smoothly. Highly recommend.

extraits.titre: I would buy this product forever
extraits.texte: i can't think of a better acne-prone, oily skin moisturizer. This is the BEST one, hands down. This never makes me breakout and it's super hydrating. Sometimes gel textures tend to "pill," but this one doesn't. it feels like the most luxurious moisturizer I've ever used
